pyqgis_plugin.name: Biome
pyqgis_plugin.description: Biome — BNG habitat mapping tool for QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.about:
Biome is a comprehensive Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) habitat mapping plugin for QGIS. Stylised EPSL species icons are derived from game-icons.net (Lorc, Delapouite) under CC BY 3.0.
It supports the full statutory BNG workflow under Schedule 7A of the Environment Act 2021, including:
• Baseline and proposed habitat mapping — area habitats, hedgerows, watercourses and individual trees • Automatic pairing of baseline and proposed features with retention/enhancement categories • BNG unit balance summary (area, hedgerow, watercourse and tree units) • De minimis check — geometric gross loss calculation against statutory thresholds (25 m² / 5 m) • Overlap warning — the Layers panel flags habitat polygons that overlap within a layer (double-counted area) • Feature Manager — view, edit, reshape, delete and restore features with a deleted feature bin • Measurements tab — area/length labels, loss layer visualisation and quick measure sketches • Desk Study tab — designated sites, priority habitats, ancient woodland, TPOs, GCN risk zones and LPA finder • Final map export and blank statutory BNG metric export • Feature Mapper for ecological features (ponds, PRF, fencing, bat boxes, etc.) • Field survey import from CSV/spreadsheet • Photo documentation tab
Data is stored in a GeoPackage alongside the QGIS project file. Requires a saved .qgz project to function.
